description.value: Town Centre Liquor Store is a large independent liquor retailer located in the Willoughby Town Centre shopping complex in Langley. It carries an extensive range of beer, wine, and spirits, and is notable for a massive walk-in cold beer fridge stocked with domestic, imported, and craft brews. A convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to pick up beverages after a ride through the Langley area.
